title: Bug Report
description: Found something that isn't working? Tell us what happened and we'll get it to the right engineers. Exact steps and screenshots help us fix it faster.

elements.name: reporterEmail
elements.title: Email address
elements.description: We will send updates about this report here.

validators.text: Please enter a valid email address.

elements.name: productArea
elements.title: Which product or area is affected?

elements.name: bugTitle
elements.title: Bug title
elements.description: One line that sums up the problem, e.g. "Export button does nothing on the Reports page".

choices.text: Critical — the product is unusable or data is lost
High — a key feature is broken and there is no workaround
Medium — a feature misbehaves but I can work around it
Low — cosmetic issue, typo, or minor annoyance

elements.name: stepsToReproduce
elements.title: Steps to reproduce
elements.description: List the exact actions that lead to the problem, one per line.

elements.name: actualResult
elements.title: Actual result
elements.description: What happened instead? Include any error message.

elements.name: firstSeen
elements.title: When did you first notice it?

elements.name: environment
elements.title: Your environment
elements.description: Fill in what you know. The app version is usually shown under Settings or About.

elements.name: attachments
elements.title: Screenshots, recordings, or log files
elements.description: Optional. Up to 5 files, 20 MB each. Please remove passwords and personal data before you upload.

elements.name: workaroundDetails
elements.title: Describe the workaround
elements.description: This helps other users while we work on a fix.

elements.name: contactAllowed
elements.title: May we contact you if we need more information?

completedHtml:
Thanks, {reporterName}. Your bug report has been submitted.

Our engineers will review {bugTitle} and we will send updates to {reporterEmail}.

completedHtmlOnCondition.html:
Thanks, {reporterName}. Your report has been flagged as critical.

Critical bugs go to the front of our queue. An engineer will look at {bugTitle} right away and contact you at {reporterEmail} as soon as there is news.
